title: Sunset ATV or UTV Guided 2 Person Offroad Tour Scottsdale
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must have valid Drivers License to drive.
Must be 8 years or older to be a passenger
Transportation can be arranged for a fee. Uber and Lyft are not recommended
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Just minutes from Scottsdale, Desert Dog Offroad takes you on a one-of-a-kind sunset adventure in the Sonoran Desert. For more than 27 years, we’ve been Scottsdale’s longest-running off-road tour company, and our guided ATV/UTV U-Drive buggy tours in the Tonto National Forest are the perfect way to end your day in Arizona.
Your adventure begins as the sun begins to fall behind the mountains, filling the desert sky with golden and fiery hues. Behind the wheel of your own ATV/UTV sand buggy, you’ll follow our expert guides across the winding desert trails. Along the way, our local guides share stories about the plants, wildlife, and secrets of the evening desert, making this more than just a ride—it’s an authentic Arizona experience.
At the midway point, we’ll stop for water and snacks (provided), giving everyone a chance to swap drivers and soak up the stunning desert views.
If you're looking for the best sunset tour in Scottsdale, see why Desert Dog Offroad delivers!
